values.description: store | uat | dev | local. Folders 03 and 04 write and refuse to run unless this is uat, dev or local.
The agent's base path in the client fleet. Not /node/v2/storeOSAgent.
SOS UI base path for the keyless fallback endpoints.
EDGE_API_KEY for this store. Never commit a real one.
Sent as X-Workstation-Name, as the agent does.
false = store offline (local handlers). true = online (forwarded to Central). Run the suite in both.
A TEST employee for the contract rows. Never a real associate.
That test employee's password, for authenticate-credentials / verify-credentials. Optional.
A barcode for the contract rows. Fake is fine — 'not found' passes the contract policy.
PIN for barcode and temp-employee steps.
Temp id the contract row register-temp-employee creates. T + 9 digits.
The ONLY id a contract-row enrolment may write a face onto. Must be T + 9 digits.
uuid for the delete-embedding contract row. Must be non-empty or the edge answers 400 Invalid Request; the fake default is fine.
Set to strict if the store enforces API keys strictly; the keyless UI rows are then expected to 401.
